docs.text:
Acharya’s account of the architecture of the Mānasāra, the Sanskrit treatise on building: towns, houses, temples and the measures of their parts.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts / Archaeological Survey of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Indian Architecture according to Manasara-Silpasastra vol.2 · Acharya, Prasanna Kumar · 1931, 282 scanned pages. Published 1931; Prasanna Kumar Acharya died 1946; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
